"84f073b5-e3b1-59e9-a055-a6e9dcf4b5cf" :question/problem "Use the substitution $u=x^{2}$. Which integral is obtained?

$$
\int 2 x \cos{\left(x^{2} \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "84f073b5-e3b1-59e9-a055-a6e9dcf4b5cf" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=x^{2}$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2 x.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 2 x \cos{\left(x^{2} \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\int \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u.
$$"] [:db/add "84f073b5-e3b1-59e9-a055-a6e9dcf4b5cf" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "84f073b5-e3b1-59e9-a055-a6e9dcf4b5cf" :question/answer-fields "Use the substitution $u=x^{3}$. Which integral is obtained?

$$
\int x^{2} \csc^{2}{\left(x^{3} \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "b2f9afef-2213-5cf4-8ac2-9379af1651a3" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=x^{3}$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=3 x^{2}.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int x^{2} \csc^{2}{\left(x^{3} \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{3}\left(\int \csc^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{1}{3}\left(\int \csc^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "b2f9afef-2213-5cf4-8ac2-9379af1651a3" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "b2f9afef-2213-5cf4-8ac2-9379af1651a3" :question/answer-fields "Use the substitution $u=x^{2}$. Which integral is obtained?

$$
\int 3 x \sec^{2}{\left(x^{2} \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "e9365dbd-fe00-591b-8075-15e95aedd5c3" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=x^{2}$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2 x.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 3 x \sec^{2}{\left(x^{2} \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \sec^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \sec^{2}{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "e9365dbd-fe00-591b-8075-15e95aedd5c3" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "e9365dbd-fe00-591b-8075-15e95aedd5c3" :question/answer-fields "21244045-a0ed-5fb6-9b86-74641c6f0660"] [:db/ensure "e9365dbd-fe00-591b-8075-15e95aedd5c3" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068917 :knowledge-point/questions "e9365dbd-fe00-591b-8075-15e95aedd5c3"] [:db/add "6d87ae77-06b9-5d22-994c-0dd36d086d92" :answer/id #uuid "6d87ae77-06b9-5d22-994c-0dd36d086d92"] [:db/add "6d87ae77-06b9-5d22-994c-0dd36d086d92" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "6d87ae77-06b9-5d22-994c-0dd36d086d92" :answer/value "- \frac{3 \csc{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)}}{2}"] [:db/ensure "6d87ae77-06b9-5d22-994c-0dd36d086d92" :answer/validate] [:db/add "b21ed25c-933f-522c-a404-61fadc00d605" :answer-field/id #uuid "b21ed25c-933f-522c-a404-61fadc00d605"] [:db/add "b21ed25c-933f-522c-a404-61fadc00d605" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "b21ed25c-933f-522c-a404-61fadc00d605" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "b21ed25c-933f-522c-a404-61fadc00d605" :answer-field/choices "6d87ae77-06b9-5d22-994c-0dd36d086d92"] [:db/add "b21ed25c-933f-522c-a404-61fadc00d605" :answer-field/correct "6d87ae77-06b9-5d22-994c-0dd36d086d92"] [:db/ensure "b21ed25c-933f-522c-a404-61fadc00d605" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "a4406e92-3fdf-528c-bc71-97d93112204f" :question/id #uuid "a4406e92-3fdf-528c-bc71-97d93112204f"] [:db/add "a4406e92-3fdf-528c-bc71-97d93112204f" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int 3 x \cot{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)} \csc{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=- \csc{\left(u \right)}+C$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "a4406e92-3fdf-528c-bc71-97d93112204f" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=x^{2} + 2$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2 x.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 3 x \cot{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)} \csc{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=- \frac{3 \csc{\left(u \right)}}{2}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
- \frac{3 \csc{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)}}{2}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "a4406e92-3fdf-528c-bc71-97d93112204f" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "a4406e92-3fdf-528c-bc71-97d93112204f" :question/answer-fields "b21ed25c-933f-522c-a404-61fadc00d605"] [:db/ensure "a4406e92-3fdf-528c-bc71-97d93112204f" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068917 :knowledge-point/questions "a4406e92-3fdf-528c-bc71-97d93112204f"] [:db/add "eb3b0d2f-07ca-580d-9045-492a80e9b799" :answer/id #uuid "eb3b0d2f-07ca-580d-9045-492a80e9b799"] [:db/add "eb3b0d2f-07ca-580d-9045-492a80e9b799" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "eb3b0d2f-07ca-580d-9045-492a80e9b799" :answer/value "- \cos{\left(x^{2} + 1 \right)}"] [:db/ensure "eb3b0d2f-07ca-580d-9045-492a80e9b799" :answer/validate] [:db/add "03634545-7861-50d0-8f73-b4884120585a" :answer-field/id #uuid "03634545-7861-50d0-8f73-b4884120585a"] [:db/add "03634545-7861-50d0-8f73-b4884120585a" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "03634545-7861-50d0-8f73-b4884120585a" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "03634545-7861-50d0-8f73-b4884120585a" :answer-field/choices "eb3b0d2f-07ca-580d-9045-492a80e9b799"] [:db/add "03634545-7861-50d0-8f73-b4884120585a" :answer-field/correct "eb3b0d2f-07ca-580d-9045-492a80e9b799"] [:db/ensure "03634545-7861-50d0-8f73-b4884120585a" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "69206d9d-63cd-5bb9-847c-bd4494453b87" :question/id #uuid "69206d9d-63cd-5bb9-847c-bd4494453b87"] [:db/add "69206d9d-63cd-5bb9-847c-bd4494453b87" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int 3 x \cot{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)} \csc{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=- \csc{\left(u \right)}+C$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "a4406e92-3fdf-528c-bc71-97d93112204f" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=x^{2} + 2$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2 x.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 3 x \cot{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)} \csc{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=- \frac{3 \csc{\left(u \right)}}{2}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
- \frac{3 \csc{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)}}{2}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "a4406e92-3fdf-528c-bc71-97d93112204f" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "a4406e92-3fdf-528c-bc71-97d93112204f" :question/answer-fields "b21ed25c-933f-522c-a404-61fadc00d605"] [:db/ensure "a4406e92-3fdf-528c-bc71-97d93112204f" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068917 :knowledge-point/questions "a4406e92-3fdf-528c-bc71-97d93112204f"] [:db/add "eb3b0d2f-07ca-580d-9045-492a80e9b799" :answer/id #uuid "eb3b0d2f-07ca-580d-9045-492a80e9b799"] [:db/add "eb3b0d2f-07ca-580d-9045-492a80e9b799" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "eb3b0d2f-07ca-580d-9045-492a80e9b799" :answer/value "- \cos{\left(x^{2} + 1 \right)}"] [:db/ensure "eb3b0d2f-07ca-580d-9045-492a80e9b799" :answer/validate] [:db/add "03634545-7861-50d0-8f73-b4884120585a" :answer-field/id #uuid "03634545-7861-50d0-8f73-b4884120585a"] [:db/add "03634545-7861-50d0-8f73-b4884120585a" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "03634545-7861-50d0-8f73-b4884120585a" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "03634545-7861-50d0-8f73-b4884120585a" :answer-field/choices "eb3b0d2f-07ca-580d-9045-492a80e9b799"] [:db/add "03634545-7861-50d0-8f73-b4884120585a" :answer-field/correct "eb3b0d2f-07ca-580d-9045-492a80e9b799"] [:db/ensure "03634545-7861-50d0-8f73-b4884120585a" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "69206d9d-63cd-5bb9-847c-bd4494453b87" :question/id #uuid "69206d9d-63cd-5bb9-847c-bd4494453b87"] [:db/add "69206d9d-63cd-5bb9-847c-bd4494453b87" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "69206d9d-63cd-5bb9-847c-bd4494453b87" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=x^{2} + 1$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2 x.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 2 x \sin{\left(x^{2} + 1 \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\int \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=- \cos{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "b24398ca-99b9-5a39-a042-a9b6d791af93" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{1}{x + 1}$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=- \frac{1}{\left(x + 1\right)^{2}}.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3 \tan{\left(\frac{1}{x + 1} \right)} \sec{\left(\frac{1}{x + 1} \right)}}{\left(x + 1\right)^{2}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=-3\left(\int \tan{\left(u \right)} \sec{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
-3\left(\int \tan{\left(u \right)} \sec{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=- 3 \sec{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

{{answer}} $+C$"] ["a4406e92-3fdf-528c-bc71-97d93112204f" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=x^{2} + 2$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2 x.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 3 x \cot{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)} \csc{\left(x^{2} + 2 \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=- \frac{3 \csc{\left(u \right)}}{2}+C.
$$

Substitute back:
